en: My family has lived here in London
for generations, so I always want to do
what's best for this city.
Welcome. How may I help you?
A deposit, perhaps?
About this thing called a bank account,
I would like to ask...
What must I do?
Well, this is a surprise.
A customer opening his first bank account...
Very well, allow me to explain.
I'm not used to civilized society, you see.
Surely you jest.
You strike me as a fine gentleman.
I'm Justin. Pleased to meet you.
I'm obliged to you.
A deposit, perhaps?... Oh. Hello.
It's you. We must be fated to meet.
When someone I know comes to the bank,
it makes me very happy.
I'll gladly help with anything you need.
Please come again.
Welcome. I've been expecting you.
What can I do for you today?
I had hoped you might tell me
a little more...
Am I intruding?
No, no, not at all
It gets hectic at midday, of course, but
I'm glad you came by.
I can also advise you on deposits, so
please come again.
, welcome.
Thank you, as always.
It's a stuffy place, but please be at ease.
Few people can relax in a bank, I suppose.
I'm always on my guard at work, too.
It is tiring, I admit.
My work keeps me on my toes. It's tiring.
I wish to be diligent, but
now and then I'd like to take it easy, too.
Shall we talk away from work next time?
I'd like a good long talk with you.
Hm? Who might you be?
Pardon me, have we met before?
No. I seem to have the wrong house.
My apologies.
Ah, I see.
Don't worry about it. It's quite all right.
Oh. You've come again?
If you have no business, I'll excuse myself.
, it's you!
The bank also handles loan inquiries.
If you need one, just ask at the bank.
Please don't hesitate to come by.
, good day to you.
Why not come in for a while?
I'd like a friendship outside of work.
I'm surrounded by such stiff, formal people.
Come by whenever you like.
You'll always be welcome.
Humans are such empty, foolish creatures
What good is working so hard?
I'll give you work worth doing,
as my servant... Hahahaha.
What a lovely morning. A day like this
Is that so? How admirable.
I'm ashamed to admit it, but I'm just
no good at getting up early.
No, please don't worry. Until next time.
(What a serious man. Hardworking, too.)
Oh, we meet again.
Are you properly awake now?
Excuse me, could you tell me the time?
My watch has stopped.
Good evening. Oh, that must be a nuisance.
You've saved me. Thank you.
You're quite right.
You've been a great help. I'm grateful.
Might I ask your name?
